recent_milestones.text: Throughput pilot: Qwen3.5:27B on the RTX 5090 drafted one six-page, visually rendered and fully text-extracted paper in 103.84 s including first model load. It correctly drafted the main recipe and Table 1 values, but inferred a correction to “300 K,” left the conflict list empty, omitted the three-repeat wash, and missed the undefined ± statistic. Draft output is not counted as an audited website contribution. Cu-Sb-S route metadata correction now passes bounded recheck; InP SI locator correction is frozen and awaiting separate re-audit; Tirosh revision-4 option identity is also pending independent recheck.

workflow.summary: High-evidence documents are extracted and audited in parallel; source-reviewed records then feed reusable material/method reader pages and separate training exports.
workflow.screening_scope: The fixed screening collection contains 10,802 distinct document contents in 10,967 source files. Main articles and SI are separate documents; exact duplicate contents are counted once in distinct-content rates. The initial screen is 99.074% complete, with 100 access-blocked items still unreviewed. New arrivals remain queued separately.
steps: Screen every fixed-cutoff document independently; preserve source copies, format holds and prior coverage. Missing companions do not block screening.
Rank measured/refined atomic-structure candidates with usable recipes first; keep phase, size and morphology-linked recipes as a separate useful tier.
Verify recipe–sample–structure evidence within each retained source, and verify source relationships when joining information from different documents.
Retain all screened candidates and gaps; external reference cells, simulations and molecular-precursor coordinates do not become measured product pairs.
Build and publish academic material readers only after the selected paper’s source, data, figure and independent audit gates pass.
workflow.capacity: User target: at least 500 source-checked website contributions/day; not achieved. The three-source pilot took roughly 5.5 hours of elapsed time from first recorded extraction milestone to final source-audit milestone and still stands at 0/3 integrated; this heterogeneous pilot interval is not a sustained daily-rate measurement. At a provisional 30–60 min per reviewed source group, 500/day requires 250–500 reviewer-hours/day before integration (32–63 eight-hour reviewers). Continue parallel extraction/audit and batch site builds; keep screen, audit, integration, and publication counts separate.
workflow.paid_processing: No paid API or cloud processing has started; the API pilot remains deferred pending the user’s decision. A local GPU is present, but no inference runtime or model weights are installed, so local AI acceleration is not currently active.
workflow.scheduled_review_frequency: Daily, as set by the user. Published milestone snapshots remain separate from scheduler wakeups.
workflow.screening_count_limit: Includes aliases and prior terminal reuse; no final-disposition or training count implied.
workflow.update_policy: Progress is published at meaningful review milestones. Drafts and source-audit passes are not counted as website contributions; each published record must retain evidence locators and clear source/sample distinctions.

estimate.summary: Target: 500 fully reviewed paper contributions per day. No end-to-end rate has been demonstrated. On one six-page Tirosh main article, Qwen3.5:27B produced a draft in 103.84 s including initial model load (about 73.8 s for prompt evaluation and generation after load). At that example-only rate, one GPU could draft roughly 390 same-size sources in an 8-hour continuous inference window after warm-up, before PDF preprocessing, independent audit, correction, page integration or browser QA. The draft mishandled an explicit source conflict and omitted details, so it cannot count as a completed contribution. Smaller local-model comparison is underway. Whole-collection finish time remains unforecastable.
estimate.current_batch: Original reader pilot: 0/3 integrated; Wu and CdSe rechecks are clear; Tirosh revision-4 option identity recheck pending. Cu-Sb-S route repair passed its bounded recheck but its site contribution is pending; InP locator correction awaits targeted audit.
notes: Frozen pass set: 5,539 distinct source contents in 5,587 copied files (48 duplicates); main articles and SI are separate screen units, not unique-paper or recipe counts.
Screening pass indicates useful synthesis/preparation evidence plus structural, phase or morphology evidence; it is not an exact sample-pair, source audit or training admission.
Keep every source-reported condition, sample and recipe variant separate. Several papers can contribute independently cited details to one material page.
When sources conflict, show both claims with their separate locators and unresolved status; do not silently normalize the wording.

Local extraction drafts are not counted as reviewed website contributions. The Qwen3.5:27B benchmark exposed a conflict-normalization error and missing work-up/statistical details; every candidate still requires an independent source check.
The local model runs offline with cloud features disabled. No paid API or external document upload is authorized.
The local site renderer previously processed 680 records in 11.5 s; source reading, independent review, conflict handling and reader QA—not HTML generation—control end-to-end throughput.
